title: Kalki 2898 AD Bujji and Bhairava
description: B & B: Bujji and BhairavaIt’s the year 2896, in future city of Kasi, Bhairava is a bounty hunter with dreams of getting into the Complex, and BU-JZ1, an AI pilot of a Cargo ship, waiting for her promotion. At their lowest point, these two unlikely souls, find each other to set off a crackling story
